title: Homelab · Machines & containers
description: Every machine with the Alloy agent (stacks/monitoring), its containers and their logs. Built by tools/build_dashboards.py.

panels.title: Machines reporting
panels.description: Machines whose agent sent their metrics in the last scrape.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Docker containers running, on every machine.

panels.title: Stale agents
panels.description: Alloy agents that sent nothing for 5 minutes, among those seen in the last day.

panels.title: Fullest disk
panels.description: The fullest filesystem on any machine.

panels.title: OOM kills
panels.description: Containers killed for running out of memory, in the time range.

panels.title: Error log lines
panels.description: Lines Loki detected as error, fatal or critical, in the time range.

panels.title: Machines
panels.description: One row per machine. Click a name to show it below.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Share of all cores, stacked.

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="integrations/node_exporter", host="$host", mode!~"idle|guest.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="integrations/node_exporter", host="$host", mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used is what can't be reclaimed: total less available.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: Runnable tasks against the number of cores: above the Cores line, work waits.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: In above the line, out below.

panels.title: Disk I/O
panels.description: Read above the line, write below.

panels.title: Filesystems
panels.description: How full each mounted filesystem is, bind mounts from the Proxmox host included.

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Share of time some task waited for CPU, memory or I/O (Linux PSI): the clearest sign a machine is short of something.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: One row per running container. CPU is in cores (100% = one core). Containers that share a network (host, or another container's) each show that network's total. Click a name for its logs.

targets.expr: max by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}) / max by (container) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"} > 0)

panels.title: CPU · top 5
panels.description: The five that used the most over the time range. 100% = one core.

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) and on(container) topk(5, sum by (container) (avg_over_time((sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])))[$__range:5m] @ end())))

panels.title: Memory · top 5
panels.description: Working set: what the kernel can't reclaim, the number an OOM kill is judged on.

targets.expr: max by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}) and on(container) topk(5, sum by (container) (avg_over_time((max by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}))[$__range:5m] @ end())))

panels.title: Network · top 5
panels.description: The five busiest over the time range, in and out together. Containers that share a network each show its total.

targets.expr: sum by (container) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8 and on(container) topk(5, sum by (container) (avg_over_time((sum by (container) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="integrations/docker", host="$host"}[$__rate_interval])) * 8)[$__range:5m] @ end())))

panels.title: Log lines by level
panels.description: Loki detects each line's level by itself.

panels.title: Errors by container
panels.description: Lines detected as error, fatal or critical.
